import java.util.*;
import java.io.*;

public class Main {
    static final long MOD = 1000000007L;
    static final long INF = (long)1e18;
    
    static long bp(long x, long y) {
        long z = 1;
        while (y > 0) {
            if ((y & 1) == 1)
                z = (z * x) % MOD;
            x = (x * x) % MOD;
            y >>= 1;
        }
        return z;
    }
    
    public static void main(String[] args) throws IOException {
        BufferedReader br = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(System.in));
        PrintWriter pw = new PrintWriter(System.out);
        
        int n = Integer.parseInt(br.readLine());
        long[][] p = new long[6][6];
        
        long inv100 = bp(100, MOD - 2);
        
        for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
            StringTokenizer st = new StringTokenizer(br.readLine());
            for (int j = 0; j < n; ++j) {
                long val = Long.parseLong(st.nextToken());
                p[i][j] = (val * inv100) % MOD;
            }
        }
        
        for (int i = n; i < 6; ++i) {
            for (int j = n; j < 6; ++j) {
                p[i][j] = 1;
            }
        }
        
        List<int[]> E = new ArrayList<>();
        for (int i = 0; i < 6; ++i) {
            for (int j = 0; j < 3; ++j) {
                E.add(new int[]{i, j});
            }
        }
        
        int[] m = new int[1 << 18];
        long[] F = new long[1 << 20];
        int nump = 0;
        
        for (int i = 0; i < 6; ++i) {
            for (int j = i + 1; j < 6; ++j) {
                for (int k = j + 1; k < 6; ++k) {
                    List<Integer> v = new ArrayList<>();
                    v.add(i);
                    v.add(j);
                    v.add(k);
                    
                    Collections.sort(v);
                    do {
                        int mask1 = ((1 << (v.get(0) * 3)) ^ (1 << (v.get(1) * 3 + 1)) ^ (1 << (v.get(2) * 3 + 2)));
                        for (int mask = 0; mask < (1 << 18); ++mask) {
                            if ((mask & mask1) == mask1) {
                                m[mask] |= (1 << nump);
                            }
                        }
                    } while (nextPermutation(v));
                    
                    nump++;
                }
            }
        }
        
        for (int mask = 0; mask < (1 << 18); ++mask) {
            long v = 1;
            for (int i = 0; i < 18; ++i) {
                if (((mask >> i) & 1) == 1) {
                    v = (v * p[E.get(i)[0]][E.get(i)[1]]) % MOD;
                } else {
                    v = (v * ((1 - p[E.get(i)[0]][E.get(i)[1]] + MOD) % MOD)) % MOD;
                }
            }
            F[m[mask]] = (F[m[mask]] + v) % MOD;
        }
        
        for (int i = 0; i < 20; ++i) {
            for (int mask = 0; mask < (1 << 20); ++mask) {
                if ((mask & (1 << i)) != 0) {
                    F[mask] = (F[mask] + F[mask ^ (1 << i)]) % MOD;
                }
            }
        }
        
        Arrays.fill(m, 0);
        nump = 0;
        E.clear();
        
        for (int i = 0; i < 6; ++i) {
            for (int j = i + 1; j < 6; ++j) {
                for (int k = j + 1; k < 6; ++k) {
                    List<Integer> v = new ArrayList<>();
                    for (int ii = 0; ii < 6; ++ii) {
                        if (ii != i && ii != j && ii != k) {
                            v.add(ii);
                        }
                    }
                    
                    Collections.sort(v);
                    do {
                        int mask1 = ((1 << (v.get(0) * 3)) ^ (1 << (v.get(1) * 3 + 1)) ^ (1 << (v.get(2) * 3 + 2)));
                        for (int mask = 0; mask < (1 << 18); ++mask) {
                            if ((mask & mask1) == mask1) {
                                m[mask] |= (1 << nump);
                            }
                        }
                    } while (nextPermutation(v));
                    
                    nump++;
                }
            }
        }
        
        for (int i = 0; i < 6; ++i) {
            for (int j = 3; j < 6; ++j) {
                E.add(new int[]{i, j});
            }
        }
        
        long ans = 0;
        for (int mask = 0; mask < (1 << 18); ++mask) {
            long v = 1;
            for (int i = 0; i < 18; ++i) {
                if (((mask >> i) & 1) == 1) {
                    v = (v * p[E.get(i)[0]][E.get(i)[1]]) % MOD;
                } else {
                    v = (v * ((1 - p[E.get(i)[0]][E.get(i)[1]] + MOD) % MOD)) % MOD;
                }
            }
            int complement = ((1 << 20) - 1) ^ m[mask];
            ans = (ans + v * ((1 - F[complement] + MOD) % MOD) % MOD) % MOD;
        }
        
        pw.println(ans);
        pw.close();
    }
    
    static boolean nextPermutation(List<Integer> arr) {
        int i = arr.size() - 2;
        while (i >= 0 && arr.get(i) >= arr.get(i + 1)) {
            i--;
        }
        if (i < 0) {
            return false;
        }
        
        int j = arr.size() - 1;
        while (arr.get(j) <= arr.get(i)) {
            j--;
        }
        
        Collections.swap(arr, i, j);
        Collections.reverse(arr.subList(i + 1, arr.size()));
        return true;
    }
}
